ai_result.long_description:
Keep small everyday essentials close at hand with this handmade leather belt pouch. Sized for compact everyday carry, it is designed to hold items such as coins, cards, cash, keys, penknives and other small essentials while walking around town or traveling.

The pouch is made from durable vegetable-tanned leather and coated with beeswax to help protect it and its contents from rain and snow. Each piece is 100% handmade, with the parts glued together and the construction finished with hand sewing using waxed thread.

Measuring 5.11 inches (13 cm) high × 4.33 inches (11 cm) wide × 1.77 inches (4.5 cm) deep, it fits standard belts up to 1.96 inches wide (up to 5 cm). A practical EDC accessory and a useful gift for a father, brother or friend.
